papers.title_en: SigmaTrace: Library-Agnostic Observability for CPU/GPU-Initiated RDMA Communication
papers.authors: Javid Baydamirli, Didem Unat
papers.evidence: 面向大规模系统虚拟化通信的RDMA可观测性
papers.tldr: RDMA网络在大规模系统中广泛应用，但缺乏细粒度可观测性，尤其GPU发起的RDMA操作完全不可见。SigmaTrace在libibverbs/mlx5dv层实现库无关追踪，采用内存插桩技术首次无侵入式捕获GPU端内核RDMA行为。实测NCCL/RCCL通信开销仅增1.3%–2%，并发现现有工具无法识别的内核屏障扩散与2.13倍跨节点流量倾斜。该工作填补了CPU/GPU协同RDMA可观测性的关键空白。
papers.abstract_en: RDMA networking enables low-latency, high-bandwidth communication on large systems. Despite its adoption, however, observability is lacking. Existing tools target specific communication libraries or only report aggregated data, missing per-operation behavior. The gap is widest for GPU-initiated networking, whose in-kernel RDMA operations are invisible to the host.   We present SigmaTrace, a library-agnostic RDMA profiling framework providing fine-grained, per-operation visibility for CPU and GPU-initiated networking. It traces operations at the libibverbs/mlx5dv layers, the common denominator beneath communication libraries on InfiniBand and RoCE, and employs a low-overhead memory interposition technique that, to our knowledge, gives the first observability into GPU-initiated RDMA without source patching or binary instrumentation.   Host-side tracing adds 1.3% overhead on NCCL AllReduce at 128 GPUs and under 2% on RCCL at 1024 GPUs. On a persistent-kernel BFS and Mixture-of-Experts inference, SigmaTrace exposes an in-kernel barrier spread and 2.13x inter-node traffic skew invisible to existing profilers.

papers.title_en: CMM-MP: A Novel Memory Pooling Architecture using Purpose-built Memory Device with CXL and Ethernet
papers.authors: Michael Wasef, Gongjin Sun, Edmund Au, Ranjitha Gopalakrishna, Elham Movahedian, Dongyang Li, Senthil Murugesapandian, Caroline Kahn, Shuyu Lyu, Brian Luu, Jason Scott, Namita Kumar, Mehdi Nik, Kwan Huen, Xuebin Yao, Amir Beygi, Luis Vitorio Cargnini, Ramdas Kachare
papers.evidence: 基于CXL的内存池化架构，面向解耦云中GPU/CPU应用
papers.tldr: 新兴内存密集型负载亟需高容量、低延迟的内存扩展方案。CMM-MP提出业界首款融合CXL与以太网的专用内存池化设备，实现无侵入式TB级内存扩容。实测延迟仅2.7 μs、吞吐达23 GB/s，显著优于RDMA方案。该架构支持池化与共享双模式，推动内存解耦实用化。
papers.abstract_en:
CXL Memory Module - Memory Pooling (CMM-MP) introduces a novel memory pooling architecture to meet the unique requirements of emerging memory-intensive workloads. This industry-first, purpose-built memory-pooling device combines the benefits of Compute Express Link (CXL) with the scalability and cost advantages of Ethernet. Multiple CMM-MP devices together provide a flexible, composable, and disaggregated memory expansion solution. The CMM-MP enables 100s of TB capacity for GPU/CPU applications without modifications. The memory pool is exposed as a large-capacity logical aggregate memory, with all pool discovery, composition, and backend network datapath tasks fully offloaded to the device. CMM-MP supports both memory pooling and sharing usage modes. It provides an application latency of 2.7 us and up to 23 GB/s of memory throughput. Our evaluations demonstrate that CMM-MP significantly outperforms RDMA-based solutions in latency and throughput. We also evaluated real-world use cases of Valkey+YCSB and DiskANN using CMM-MP.

---

papers.title_en: gKSM: GPU Memory Deduplication at Driver Layer for Serverless LLM Inference
papers.authors: Shuheng Gao, Fan Guo, Yongkun Li, Ziye Yue, Yinlong Xu, John C. S. Lui
papers.evidence: 面向云服务器无服务LLM推理的GPU内存去重框架
papers.tldr: 服务器无服务器LLM推理中，多实例共驻单GPU导致模型权重与运行时状态重复占用GPU内存。gKSM在驱动层实现透明GPU内存去重，融合CPU-GPU协同哈希、零拷贝权重去重与跨特权页错误处理。实测GPU内存降低59.8%，内存受限下聚合吞吐提升2.15倍。首次在GPU侧高效支持写隔离与COW语义，显著提升资源利用率与服务可用性。
papers.abstract_en:
In serverless LLM inference, cloud providers commonly locate multiple instances on a single GPU to improve utilization. However, each instance independently maintains its model weights and runtime state, making duplicate GPU memory the primary bottleneck. Memory deduplication is a widely-used technique for eliminating duplicate data in CPU systems, but extending it to GPU memory faces fundamental challenges. Effective GPU memory deduplication must avoid redundant data movement between CPU and GPU while preserving write isolation for shared pages without native copy-on-write (COW) support.   This paper presents gKSM, a transparent GPU memory deduplication framework for serverless LLM inference. gKSM addresses these challenges through CPU-GPU collaborative hash management that offloads hash computation to GPU kernels, zero-copy model weight deduplication that eliminates duplication before model weight transfer, and a cross-privilege page fault handler that combines a lightweight kernel hook and CUDA Virtual Memory Management (VMM) remapping in the user space. gKSM also designs a stable page scanning algorithm and a reuse-aware placement policy in cluster scale. Experiments show that gKSM reduces GPU memory usage by 59.8% while maintaining high throughput compared to ServerlessLLM. Under memory constrained workloads, gKSM improves aggregate throughput by 2.15X and supports five instances concurrently. In cluster level simulation, gKSM achieves a service rate of 99.97%, compared to 78.2% for SLInfer and 26.9% for ServerlessLLM.

---

papers.title_en: PAGE404: Breaking GPU Isolation Through Hardware-assisted Page Migration
papers.authors: Ravan Nazaraliyev, Yicheng Zhang, Nael Abu-Ghazaleh
papers.evidence: 硬件辅助页迁移机制影响统一内存架构下Linux内核内存管理的局部性与回收行为
papers.tldr: NVIDIA Grace Hopper超芯片通过硬件辅助页迁移实现CPU-GPU统一内存，但该机制引入新型侧信道风险。研究发现访问计数器共享与UVM中断处理两处漏洞，可跨MIG实例构建高带宽隐蔽信道。实测速率超8.1 kbps，并能指纹识别LLM推理负载。揭示了异构内存系统中硬件管理机制带来的隔离失效新范式。
papers.abstract_en: NVIDIA's Grace Hopper (GH200) superchip represents a new generation of heterogeneous computing, tightly integrating a 72-core Arm-based CPU with a Hopper GPU on a single module via a high-bandwidth, cache-coherent interconnect. By eliminating the conventional PCIe bottleneck for CPU-GPU data movement, this design establishes a unified memory domain that scales to the capacities demanded by generative AI and high-performance computing (HPC) workloads. The architecture also introduces hardware-assisted page migration: driven by access counters, the system dynamically promotes frequently accessed pages from host CPU memory to GPU DRAM to improve memory locality. We study the security of this emerging architecture against new side- and covert-channel attacks targeting its page migration support. We analyze counter-driven migration across both the hardware mechanisms and the UVM driver's interrupt-handling pipeline, and identify two side-channel vulnerabilities: one rooted in the shared structure of access counters, and the other in the driver's response to migration interrupts. We further show that both channels are exploitable across Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) partitions, a feature intended to provide strong, hardware-enforced isolation between co-located tenants. Using proof-of-concept attacks, we build covert channels that reach roughly 8,500 bits per second through eviction-based signaling and 8,100 bits per second through migration-delay-based signaling across MIG instances. The interrupt-based channel also fingerprints inference workloads across distinct large language models (LLMs) and CPU SPEC2017 benchmarks, and estimates the prompt length processed during LLM inference with high accuracy. These results expose a security gap in hardware-managed heterogeneous memory systems and call into question the isolation guarantees of current MIG-enabled multi-tenant GPU deployments.

papers.title_en: MailRail: Mitigating Incast Congestion with User-Space, Node-Based Flow Control
papers.authors: Noel Gomillion, Lance Fletcher, Trevor Steil, Eun Jung Kim, Roger Pearce
papers.evidence: 用户态节点级流控应对突发拥塞，提升Linux内核网络栈在不规则负载下的可扩展性
papers.tldr: 1对抗性incast下提速1132倍，均匀负载开销极低。该设计突破高密度进程下传统rank级信用机制的内存瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Irregular workloads, such as those stemming from Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, frequently induce severe incast congestion in large-scale parallel environments. Existing fabric-level congestion control mechanisms rely on reactive, link-level rate limiting that degrades overall throughput. While receiver-driven, credit-based flow control offers a proactive alternative, as process counts scale memory slots per rank fall below usable thresholds, rendering traditional rank-based accounting untenable. To address this challenge, we introduce MailRail, an out-of-order, asynchronous messaging framework, along with a novel user-space, node-based credit flow control system. By shifting credit accounting from individual processes to shared per-node pools, our proactive, fabric-agnostic approach maintains sufficient credit availability even as process density grows, enabling processes to dynamically utilize freed credits without waiting for receiver-side redistribution. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that node-based flow control achieves up to a 1132x speedup over unconstrained execution at an adversarial incast ratio of 4096:1 while adding minimal overhead on uniform workloads.

papers.title_en: PairSight: Characterizing and Predicting Operator-Level Interference in GPU Sharing for DNN Inference
papers.authors: Xiao Liu, Yujia Fu, Yue Yu, Dan Huang
papers.evidence: 基于硬件计数器的GPU共享中算子级干扰表征
papers.tldr: GPU共享推理常因算子间干扰导致性能下降，现有方法缺乏细粒度建模。PairSight基于SM分区下硬件计数器追踪，揭示共享内存路径上的联合算子竞争机制。其预测误差仅4.3%，显著优于基线；支持LLM等新模型冷启动适配。为GPU多租户推理提供了可解释、高精度的算子级干扰预测框架。
papers.abstract_en: Serving DNN inference is costly, yet a single task seldom saturates both the compute units and the memory bandwidth of a GPU. GPU sharing raises utilization by co-locating several tasks on one GPU, at the cost of interference among them. Existing systems estimate this interference with binary compute-memory rules, standalone scaling curves, or model-level predictors. However, these estimates rest on a limited understanding of interference. They leave the software and hardware properties of co-located operators largely unexplored and give no slowdown prediction that is both interpretable and accurate. We conduct an operator-level study of interference under SM partitioning and use hardware counters to trace it to contention on the shared memory path, where the slowdown depends jointly on both co-located operators. Based on these findings, we propose PairSight, a hardware-aware interference predictor that learns how the hardware behaviors of co-located tasks interact and predicts the latency of each task before co-location. On six DNN models including LLMs, PairSight predicts latency under sharing with 4.3% mean error, against 19.0% for a compute-memory intensity rule, and adapts to unseen models and inputs with a few samples.

papers.title_en: A mechanism for TCP-aware Active Queue Management in packet-forwarding devices
papers.authors: Swarnarup Bhunia, Somit Gond, Vayun Goel, Sreelakshmi Manjunath, Padmanabhan Rajan
papers.evidence: 面向TCP的主动队列管理机制，优化网络栈拥塞控制与丢包阈值协同
papers.tldr: 缓冲膨胀问题导致路由器大缓存持续拥塞，传统AQM需人工调参且依赖TCP参数，部署困难。本文提出TCP感知的自适应AQM机制，实时估计端系统cwnd并动态计算最优丢包阈值。仿真表明其在延迟、吞吐与公平性上优于RED、PI等策略。该机制天然适配SDN架构，控制器计算阈值、交换机执行丢包。
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of Active Queue Management (AQM) policies is known to be a promising solution to bufferbloat, the problem of persistently-full large buffers in Internet routers. However, most AQMs involve tunable parameters, and some require awareness of the characteristics of the transport-layer protocol implemented at the end systems, thereby rendering their deployment infeasible. We consider one such AQM-- a threshold-based queue policy which requires the packet-dropping threshold to be co-designed with relevant TCP parameters. We propose a mechanism that detects network congestion, estimates the congestion window evolution in the end hosts, estimates the required TCP parameter, and produces an optimal value of the packet-dropping threshold. Arguments based on analysis of the TCP fluid model are presented to substantiate the proposed mechanism. A simulation-based performance evaluation reveals the effectiveness of the proposed mechanism, compared to some widely implemented queue policies, in terms of various user- and system-oriented metrics. The proposed mechanism is particularly well-suited for implementation in Software Defined Networks (SDN) where the algorithms can run in the SDN controller and the packet-dropping threshold can be implemented in the data-plane switches through open interfaces.

papers.title_en: Ineffective Occupancy in Heterogeneous GPU Clusters: Prediction, Contribution Analysis, and Readiness-Aware Scheduling
papers.authors: Tao Zhang, Bin Liao
papers.evidence: 面向异构GPU集群中作业就绪状态的调度优化
papers.tldr: 异构GPU集群中存在大量无效占用：作业已调度但长期无法就绪，造成资源浪费。本文提出就绪感知调度RAS，基于9个 admission 时可观测特征预测就绪概率。在阿里GPU集群trace上，无效占用率从43.64%降至27.15%，大请求有效覆盖率提升17.07个百分点。证明就绪状态是可测、可预测、可优化的关键调度维度。
papers.abstract_en: In heterogeneous GPU clusters, GPUs are costly and scarce, yet placing a job on a machine does not mean that the job becomes ready to run. A large amount of allocated capacity can remain occupied for long periods without producing useful computation, further aggravating the waste of compute resources. On the Alibaba GPU cluster trace we find that, even when GPU capacity is sufficient and placement is complete, 52.70% of execution records never became ready. We term this phenomenon ineffective occupancy. Building on this diagnosis, and keeping the placement policy fixed, we propose Readiness-Aware Scheduling (RAS): it uses only nine attributes observable at admission time to predict readiness probability and reorders admission accordingly. Under a five-fold split grouped by machine, the gradient-boosted model reaches an ROC-AUC of 0.8187. A feature-group contribution analysis shows that the model's score is driven mainly by job profile, duration, and GPU model, with the request-size group contributing least, followed by the scheduling and concurrency group. In GPU terms, RAS reduces the ineffective-occupancy ratio (the share of cluster GPUs held under ineffective occupancy) from 43.64% to 27.15% and raises the effective coverage of large requests (eight GPUs or more) from 46.11% to 63.18%, without sacrificing capacity utilization. Relative to the upper bound obtained by ordering with ground-truth labels, RAS captures 65.1% of the attainable improvement, well above the interpretable rules built only from the contribution-analysis conclusions; the gain therefore comes mainly from predicting with all nine attributes jointly rather than from combining rules built on any single attribute group. These results indicate that readiness status is a measurable, predictable, and optimizable dimension of admission decisions in heterogeneous GPU clusters.

papers.title_en: HyCo: Hybrid Drafting for Cost-Efficient Mobile-Cloud Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Hanbin Bae, Heejin Choi, Joohyung Lee, Byoung Jin Choi, Sangjun Park, Hoon-Young Cho
papers.evidence: 移动-云协同推测解码架构
papers.tldr: 移动-云协同推测解码中，小语言模型（SLM）在手机NPU上多轮展开深draft树开销大。HyCo将服务器MTP头卸载至设备执行，SLM仅单次前向传播生成分支，并通过量化、受限词表与1K窗口适配NPU。相比服务端MTP自推测，GPU耗时降低29.2%–38.6%，且保持判分无显著下降。该设计兼顾效率、精度与端侧可行性。
papers.abstract_en:
Device-cloud speculative decoding reduces server computation, but growing a deep draft tree with a small language model (SLM) requires repeated passes on a mobile neural processing unit (NPU). We present HyCo, which assigns depth to the server model's native multi-token prediction (MTP) head, executed on the device, and alternative branches to one SLM pass. The server returns the hidden state, input embedding, and key-value entries needed by the head instead of executing its sequential steps. Quantization, a restricted vocabulary, and a 1K-token window fit both drafters to the NPU. An ε-threshold rule additionally relaxes exact preservation of the verifier's sampling distribution. In single-client runs with a Galaxy S26 Ultra over LTE/5G, HyCo reduces server GPU time per output token relative to server-side MTP self-speculation by 38.6% on Spec-Bench and 29.2% on 32K-token summarization. With the same acceptance rule, three Spec-Bench runs per system show 9.0 percentage points more saving and 1.9x delivery speed than an SLM-only drafter. HyCo differs from Cloud+MTP by +0.2 judge-score points (paired 95% CI: -0.9 to +1.3); exploratory translation favors SpecEdge-ε. Without relaxation, HyCo exact saves 27.7% and 11.9% on the two datasets.

---

papers.title_en: Benchmarking Post-Quantum Key Encapsulation in S3-Compatible Object Storage under Client Concurrency
papers.authors: Revanth Reddy Lingala, K. Gangadhara Rao, Padigela Srujan, Saarthak Manocha, Vainavi Venkat
papers.evidence: S3兼容云对象存储中的后量子密钥封装基准测试
papers.tldr: 云对象存储中长期保存的数据面临量子计算威胁，需用ML-KEM等后量子密钥封装算法替代经典密钥交换。本文在S3兼容存储系统中，实测客户端并发场景下ML-KEM对吞吐量的影响。结果表明仅在CPU近满载时吞吐量下降4.0–4.9%，主因是库调用方式而非算法本身；存储开销固定增加1056字节/对象。该工作首次量化了真实存储负载下的PQ加密代价。
papers.abstract_en:
Data encrypted today with classical public-key algorithms could be decrypted once large quantum computers exist. Cloud object stores keep data for years, so the client-side encryption that protects it must move to post-quantum algorithms such as ML-KEM, which adds a key-encapsulation step and a larger ciphertext to every stored object. So far, the cost of ML-KEM has been measured for the algorithm on its own and for securing network connections, but not for encrypting each object in a storage system that serves many clients at once. It has therefore been unclear whether ML-KEM slows such a system, under which conditions, and why. We address this problem by measuring per-object ML-KEM against classical key exchange on an S3-compatible object store, with two client implementations, two processor types and up to 500 concurrent workers, using pre-registered experiments and statistical equivalence tests. ML-KEM reduced throughput only when the client's processor was at or near full load, with one unexplained exception, and then by 4.0 to 4.9% in our main client. Controlled experiments on one processor type traced most of that loss to the way the software library was called, and a second, native client showed that the size of the loss depends on the implementation. The lasting cost is storage: 1,056 more bytes per object than with classical key exchange. The results cover two clients, one single-node store and one cloud provider.

---

papers.title_en: ScaleRAN: A Runtime for Elastic GPU Resource Management in AI-RAN
papers.authors: Arthur Hamard, Jérémie Leguay, Gopalasingham Aravinthan, Alberto Conte, Julien Lallet, Abdelkader Outtagarts
papers.evidence: 面向云原生基础设施的AI-RAN弹性GPU资源管理运行时
papers.tldr: AI-RAN需在GPU平台上协同运行时延敏感的RAN基带处理与AI任务，但现有GPU共享机制难以应对毫秒级slot负载波动。ScaleRAN基于NVIDIA Green Contexts实现SM级弹性分区，支持slot粒度动态资源重分配。实验表明其在保障RAN截止时间前提下显著提升AI任务可用GPU资源。该工作为O-RAN O-Cloud等AI-RAN部署提供了首个轻量、可预测的节点级GPU运行时。
papers.abstract_en:
AI-RAN is driving the convergence of radio access network (RAN) processing and artificial intelligence (AI) workloads on GPU-enabled computing platforms, ranging from GPU-accelerated base stations to cloud-native infrastructures. While GPU acceleration improves the efficiency of virtualized RAN functions, the computational demand of latency-critical baseband processing varies with traffic load, creating transient spare GPU capacity that can be reclaimed by co-located AI applications. Existing GPU-sharing mechanisms rely on coarse-grained hardware partitioning or static resource allocation, limiting their ability to adapt to slot-level workload fluctuations while preserving strict timing requirements.   This paper presents ScaleRAN, a node-local runtime for elastic GPU resource management in AI-RAN. ScaleRAN leverages NVIDIA Green Contexts to dynamically partition Streaming Multiprocessors (SMs) between RAN and AI workloads through a ladder of pre-created GPU partitions, enabling low-overhead resource reallocation at RAN slot granularity. The proposed runtime naturally supports Open-RAN (O-RAN) O-Cloud deployments, one representative AI-RAN deployment scenario. To drive these reallocations, we propose a reactive controller inspired by Kubernetes autoscaling and a proactive controller based on quantile regression and conformal prediction. We also develop LDPCSim, a GPU-accelerated workload generator built on NVIDIA Aerial for reproducible evaluation. Results show that predictive fine-grained GPU partitioning satisfies slot-level RAN deadlines while increasing the GPU resources available to co-located AI workloads, demonstrating the practicality of elastic GPU sharing for future AI-RAN platforms.

---

papers.title_en: Task Offloading and Resource Allocation for Deterministic Service Provisioning in the IoT-Edge-Cloud Continuum
papers.authors: K. Aghababaiyan, B. Coll-Perales, J. Gozalvez
papers.evidence: 物联网-边缘-云连续体中的确定性任务卸载
papers.tldr: 物联网-边缘-云连续体需支撑确定性服务保障。本文提出面向SLO的确定性任务卸载与资源分配方案，以最大化按时完成任务数为目标，联合优化通信与计算资源。相比传统低延迟/低能耗策略，该方案通过差异化任务时延需求实现负载均衡与高优先级任务保障。实验表明其在资源扩展性与时限保证能力上显著提升。
papers.abstract_en:
Future networks will seamlessly integrate computing and communication resources within a unified ecosystem of IoT devices, edge nodes, and cloud servers, forming an IoT-edge-cloud continuum. Within such an ecosystem, tasks can be dynamically offloaded to leverage resources across the continuum and efficiently scale with demand. Task offloading has traditionally focused on minimizing task execution latency or energy consumption. In contrast, we propose a deterministic task offloading and resource allocation scheme for the joint management of communication and computing resources to support services with deterministic service-level requirements. The proposed scheme aims to maximize the number of tasks completed on time, rather than minimizing the latency of individual tasks. To do so, it exploits variable task latency requirements to distribute the workload across the continuum. It can also prioritize high-priority tasks under resource scarcity. Numerical evaluations demonstrate that a deterministic task offloading strategy scales more effectively and can better guarantee timely task completion by balancing resource utilization across the continuum.

---

papers.title_en: Holistic Buoyancy-Driven Cloud Native Resource Management
papers.authors: Oliver Larsson, Thijs Metsch, Cristian Klein, Erik Elmroth
papers.evidence: 基于运行时工作负载浮力的自适应资源管理适用于云原生Linux环境
papers.tldr: 多租户云环境中，缓存与内存带宽等共享资源动态拥塞，导致SLO违规频发。本文提出基于运行时工作负载浮力（buoyancy）的全周期资源管理框架。在高拥塞场景下，SLO达标率从7.74%提升至87.8%，显著缓解资源争用与集群碎片。该方法为云原生环境提供了无需先验知识的自适应资源治理新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Efficient resource management is a challenge in multi-tenant cloud environments as workloads compete for shared resources such as last-level cache and memory bandwidth, whose congestion can change dynamically as workload composition and resource demands evolve. Existing resource management approaches often rely on static resource requirements or prior workload profiling, limiting their ability to respond to changing resource contention as required in the cloud. In this paper, we leverage workload buoyancy, a runtime framework for capturing workload sensitivity to individual resources and application-level performance, to enable adaptive scheduling and resource management. We propose a holistic approach that incorporates buoyancy into workload scheduling, node-local resource allocation, and workload rescheduling throughout the workload lifecycle. We implement our approach as a Kubernetes-native prototype and evaluate it on a multi-node cluster using diverse cloud workloads under varying levels of resource contention. In a high-congestion scenario, our approach increases the percentage of workloads satisfying their SLOs from 7.74% to 87.8% on average compared with the Kubernetes baseline, while reducing resource congestion, the severity of SLO violations, and cluster fragmentation using limited rescheduling.

papers.title_en: Weight Placement Is Not Enough: Synchronization in Multi-Node CPU Decoding of Ternary LLMs
papers.authors: Runguo Li, Dezhen Lu
papers.evidence: CPU端LLM解码中的NUMA感知同步分析
papers.tldr: ternary LLM解码在多路Xeon服务器上严重受限于跨NUMA节点同步开销，而非内存带宽。本文提出Megatron式列切分替代行切分，并优化线程级等待均衡。实测提速1.5–2.1×，小模型达3.2×，能耗降低且精度不变。揭示了权重放置之外，同步设计才是多节点CPU推理的关键瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Ternary LLMs read only a few gigabytes per decoded token, yet on dual-socket servers with four NUMA nodes the fastest ternary runtime we found uses less than half of the memory bandwidth. Placing each weight on the node of the thread that reads it is necessary but not enough: in a decode engine with node-local weights that reuses ik_llama's kernels, threads on two generations of Xeon servers still spend 20-48% of each token waiting at synchronization points. Per-thread barrier traces show that most of the wait is for the slowest threads of each node; the barriers' own latency (microseconds each, but up to 12% of the token for the smallest model) and serial per-node work are smaller parts. On identical kernels, a Megatron-style column split beats a row-owned split without cross-node reductions in every configuration we measured, and isolating the number of barriers shows that most of its gain comes from its threads waiting less for each other and for their node leaders, and only a minority from having fewer barriers. Where decoding is DRAM-bound, the resulting engine is 1.5-2.1x faster than ik_llama with all cores and 1.5-1.9x faster than ik_llama at its fastest thread count (3.2x and 2.8x for a small model that runs from the L3 cache), at the same accuracy and with less energy per token.

papers.title_en: uGDS: A User-Space Development Kit for High-Performance GPU Direct Storage
papers.authors: Jing Wei, Guanyi Chen, Qi Chen, Chuyu Zhang, Zheng Zhou, Chutian Wang, Jian Zhang
papers.evidence: 用户态GPU Direct Storage库支持SSD-GPU直传，与QEMU虚拟化I/O栈兼容
papers.tldr: GPU密集型应用依赖NVMe SSD扩展显存，但NVIDIA GDS存在内核控制开销大、流序过度严格、闭源难定制等问题。uGDS构建全用户态GPU Direct Storage栈，解耦控制与数据路径，支持跨厂商抽象与细粒度调度。实测A100+990 PRO上批读/写带宽达GDS的12.12×/30.69×，TTFT降低62.7%。它是首个开源、跨CUDA/HIP、高透明且可诊断的GDS替代方案。
papers.abstract_en: Data-intensive GPU applications increasingly rely on NVMe SSDs to extend GPU memory. NVIDIA GPU Direct Storage (GDS) enables direct SSD-GPU transfers via PCIe peer-to-peer DMA, eliminating host staging. However, GDS retains three key limitations: (1) its control path traverses the kernel for every I/O request, introducing software overhead; (2) its stream-ordered path imposes strict total ordering even when workloads only require batch-level ordering; and (3) its closed-source user-space engine hinders diagnosis and custom scheduling.   We present uGDS, https://github.com/ScaleX-IO/uGDS, an open-source user-space GPU Direct Storage library built on four principles: user-space control, unified cross-vendor abstraction, workload-aware scheduling, and end-to-end transparency. The host CPU manages the entire NVMe command lifecycle in user space, while payloads move via PCIe P2P DMA without consuming GPU compute. A minimal kernel module (ugds_drv.ko) is used only for one-time privileged setup. uGDS partitions hardware queues between synchronous and batch traffic, enforces DMA-safe buffer lifetimes, and provides cuFile-compatible synchronous, batched, and stream-ordered APIs with polling or interrupt completion on both NVIDIA CUDA and AMD HIP.   Evaluated on an A100 with a Samsung 990 PRO, uGDS achieves up to 12.12x GDS's batch-read bandwidth and 30.69x its batch-write bandwidth (8- and 4-KiB requests, batch size 128), and reduces 4-KiB synchronous write latency by 84.1% with two threads. Its stream-ordered path sustains 5.49 GiB/s on a single stream, where GDS retains only 40.8% of its synchronous bandwidth. In LMCache, uGDS reduces median time-to-first-token (TTFT) by up to 62.7% and raises serving goodput by 2.63x. On AMD, uGDS achieves up to 1.19x hipFile's synchronous-write bandwidth.

papers.title_en: CXLResume: Retained-State Checkpoint and Restore for In-Memory Services
papers.authors: Haonan Li, Zhaoxiang Huang, Zhihao Zhang, Yiming Zhang
papers.evidence: 基于CXL共享内存的内存服务检查点与恢复机制
papers.tldr: 内存服务传统检查点需全量拷贝内存页，开销巨大。CXLResume利用CXL共享内存保留主堆对象，仅序列化执行状态与映射元数据。Redis和Memcached在6 GiB场景下恢复时间降至0.24–0.28秒。该方法显著规避大堆数据搬运，为低延迟容错提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Checkpointing and restoring an in-memory service typically require writing its memory pages to checkpoint images and refilling them at the destination. When application state already resides in shared memory that remains accessible after failover, copying those pages into and out of checkpoint images is unnecessary. We present CXLResume, a prototype that retains the service's main heap objects in shared memory while checkpointing the remaining execution state and mapping metadata. Checkpointing preserves the shared heap at the same freeze point as the serialized process state. During recovery, CXLResume remaps the same shared memory at its original virtual addresses before restoring execution, preserving direct pointers within and across shared and private memory. We evaluate CXLResume with Redis and Memcached using QEMU CXL functional emulation. At 6 GiB, CXLResume reduces combined checkpoint and restore time from 15.015 s to 0.242 s for Redis and from 19.770 s to 0.276 s for Memcached in the evaluated deployments. These results show that retaining shared application state removes large application heaps from the checkpoint data path and substantially reduces checkpoint and restore latency.

papers.title_en: HAWK: Heterogeneity-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Efficient GPU-NPU Phase-Disaggregated LLM Inference
papers.authors: Junhyeok Park, Jungeun Yoon, Kyungmin Kim, Hunsoon Lee, Shinyoung Ahn, Kangho Kim
papers.evidence: 异构虚拟化系统中GPU-NPU相位分离的大语言模型推理
papers.tldr: LLM推理预填充（prefill）与解码（decode）阶段计算特性迥异，导致单一硬件难以兼顾效率。HAWK提出异构GPU-NPU协同架构，通过RDMA路径实现KV缓存跨设备零拷贝迁移。实测在SLO约束下性能达GPU单系统92.12%，功耗与成本效率分别提升1.26×和1.72×。该方案为相位解耦推理提供了实用化异构加速范式。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) inference exhibits distinct computational characteristics across its two phases: prefill is compute-intensive, whereas decode is more memory-bound. As a result, AI accelerators achieve varying levels of efficiency across the two phases. GPUs are well suited to prefill, but are often underutilized during decode. By contrast, NPUs can utilize their compute resources more effectively during decode. Motivated by this observation, we explore a heterogeneous architecture that integrates GPUs and NPUs, mapping prefill to GPUs and decode to NPUs to achieve high performance and efficiency. However, realizing such heterogeneous integration is challenging because LLM phase disaggregation requires KV cache transfer from prefill to decode (that is, from GPUs to NPUs), which is complicated by differences in inter-device communication mechanisms and KV cache tensor layouts.   To address this, we propose HAWK, a transfer mechanism that enables rapid KV cache transfer across heterogeneous devices. HAWK establishes a remote direct memory access (RDMA) path for direct cross-device transfers while handling inter-device tensor layout discrepancies as part of the transfer process. In particular, HAWK allocates tensor-layout-aware RDMA buffers on the NPU side to match the target tensor layout. Leveraging these buffers, HAWK orchestrates data transfer from a conventional contiguous GPU RDMA buffer to the corresponding NPU buffers, allowing transferred tensors to be consumed directly without additional data rearrangement while maintaining transfer efficiency. We implement and evaluate HAWK on a system built with commercially available GPUs and NPUs, demonstrating performance within 7.88% of a GPU-only system under the same SLO constraints while achieving up to 1.26$\times$ higher power efficiency and 1.72$\times$ higher cost efficiency.

papers.title_en: Understanding NVIDIA Grace-Blackwell Unified Memory Through Placement-Controlled Microbenchmarks
papers.authors: Nathan Graddon, Aaron Jarmusch, Sunita Chandrasekaran
papers.evidence: 统一内存需求迁移与驱逐行为的微基准分析
papers.tldr: NVIDIA Grace-Blackwell架构虽提供统一地址空间，但内存实际服务路径差异巨大。本文设计 placement-controlled 微基准，解耦HBM本地访问、主机内存访问、迁移、预取等行为。实测GB200上带宽跨度达13倍（3963 GB/s vs 304 GB/s），并揭示容量压力下性能陡降。该工作为UM性能建模与优化提供了可复现的量化基础。
papers.abstract_en: NVIDIA Grace--Blackwell systems make CPU--GPU memory increasingly unified at the programming level, but unified addressability does not make the memory system uniform. A CUDA managed allocation on GB200 may be served from GPU-local HBM, accessed through host/system memory, demand-migrated, prefetched, reused after GPU access, or evicted and reloaded under capacity pressure. The problem is that these states share a programming interface while exercising different hardware paths and runtime mechanisms, making a single ``Unified Memory bandwidth'' number misleading.   This paper presents a placement-controlled microbenchmark study of CUDA Unified Memory on NVIDIA GB200, using GH200 as a Grace--Hopper baseline and GB10/DGX Spark as a validation platform. Our methodology separates local HBM access, host/system-memory access, explicit movement, managed first touch, prefetch, reuse, access-pattern sensitivity, oversubscription, and CPU--GPU handoff, then summarizes the observations with a measurement-calibrated model of compute, access, migration, eviction, synchronization, and handoff costs. On GB200, a 1~GB STREAM-style triad reaches 3963~GB/s from local HBM but 304~GB/s through host-mapped CPU/system memory; for a 256~MB streaming kernel, cold CPU-initialized managed memory reaches 14.1~GB/s, while managed prefetch and reuse reach 4606~GB/s and 4504~GB/s. Below the capacity boundary, prefetched and reused managed memory remain above 4.6~TB/s, but at 125\% of CUDA-visible memory they fall to 968~GB/s and 1214~GB/s, showing that Grace--Blackwell unified memory must be understood through placement, access history, locality, reuse, and capacity pressure.

papers.title_en: Characterizing Predictability-Latency Trade-offs of KV-Cache SSD Offloading in LMCache for LLM Serving Systems
papers.authors: Ying He, Dingsen Shi, Yanbo Dai, Donger Chen, Harry Fu, Chris Tsu, Wang Feng, Song Fu
papers.evidence: 刻画LMCache中内核页缓存行为对SSD卸载的影响
papers.tldr: KV缓存SSD卸载在大模型服务中广泛用于扩展GPU内存，但其块设备层行为缺乏实证刻画。本文基于LMCache在四类真实多会话负载下的表现，对比0.3.0（buffered I/O+页缓存）与0.3.16（前缀感知去重+O_DIRECT）两版部署。发现页缓存冷热状态显著影响读放大，去重仅对精确重复提示有效，O_DIRECT使读延迟显式化且稳定。揭示了可预测性与平均延迟间的本质权衡。
papers.abstract_en: KV-cache offload is widely used to stretch GPU memory for LLM serving, but its storage behavior has not been characterized at the block-device level. In this paper, we study LMCache through realworld multi-session workloads that span same/different context x same/different prompt, using over 100 stateless requests per workload. Our comparison is observational rather than factorial: it contrasts two realizable deployment snapshots -- LMCache 0.3.0 with buffered I/O and the kernel page cache, and LMCache 0.3.16 with prefix-aware deduplication and O_DIRECT. Key findings define the paper. First, the legacy stack appears almost read-free at the SSD layer in all four workloads, but a flush_ram experiment shows that this is conditional on page-cache warmth: once the cache is evicted, the same path issues about 1 GB of sequential reads in 683 ms. Second, deduplication delivers a dramatic write reduction only for the exact-repeat workload: one set collapses from 1.62 GB to 11.75 MB of writes, while the other three sets remain in the 2-5 GB range. Third, O_DIRECT converts a hidden and bimodal read cost into an explicit and stable one: on one set, warm TTFT rises from 27 ms to 93 ms because each of the 99 warm requests re-reads the same ~12 MB partial chunk from SSD. The main conclusion is therefore not "newer is better," but a system trade-off: predictability versus average-case latency.

papers.title_en: Benchmarking and Enhancing Design-Aware Code Review in the Linux Kernel
papers.authors: Zhenhao Zhou, Kai Yu, Ying Wang, Zhiqiang Yuan, Junhao Zeng, Yijian Wu, Chong Wang, Xin Peng
papers.evidence: 面向Linux内核的设计感知代码审查聚焦调度与内存等性能关键子系统的权衡分析
papers.tldr: Linux内核代码审查需识别设计权衡而非仅局部缺陷，但现有工具难以复用历史评审中的设计知识。本文提出DesignLore，从历史讨论中提取并结构化设计决策，构建自适应设计分类法。在DesignReviewBench基准上，其F1达0.259，相对提升21.6%。该工作首次系统推动设计感知型自动化代码审查。
papers.abstract_en: Code review often requires reasoning beyond local correctness. In mature software systems, reviewers must recognize design trade-offs introduced by a proposed change, compare alternative solutions, and reason about their compatibility with project-specific constraints. We refer to this problem as design-aware code review. However, existing automated review approaches primarily focus on defects and correctness, while the design knowledge accumulated in historical review discussions remains difficult to reuse.   To address these challenges, we present DesignLore, a knowledge-augmented approach that extracts design decisions from historical review discussions, organizes them into an adaptive design taxonomy, and reuses relevant historical knowledge to guide code review. We further construct DesignReviewBench, a benchmark derived from real patch-review histories for systematically evaluating design-aware code review. Our evaluation shows that design-aware review remains challenging for current coding agents, with the strongest baseline achieving an F1 of only 0.213 on design trade-off detection. In comparison, DesignLore achieves an F1 of 0.259, a 21.6% relative improvement, and consistently delivers gains across different agent systems and backbone. These results highlight the importance of design-aware review and demonstrate the potential of recovering and reusing historical design knowledge to support it.

papers.title_en: Heuristic-Driven Resource Optimization for Decoupled Memory Channels on FPGAs
papers.authors: Arnab A. Purkayastha, Shobhit Aggarwal, Jay Tharwani
papers.evidence: 基于LLVM的静态分析优化FPGA DAE架构内存通道深度
papers.tldr: FPGA上DAE架构的OpenCL通道深度配置常被静态工具过度预留，造成资源浪费。本文提出硬件感知的启发式精化层，利用基线内存停顿与性能饱和的反直觉关联优化深度。实验在HotSpot等基准上验证其精准定位最小峰值性能点，资源效率提升2.52倍。该方法兼顾峰值加速与硬件精简，突破保守静态预测瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Determining OpenCL channel depths for Decoupled Access-Execute (DAE) architectures in High-Level Synthesis (HLS) is critical for balancing performance and hardware efficiency. Conventional static analysis tools often over-provision these memory channels to ensure performance safety, leading to significant resource stranding. This paper presents an expansion of an LLVM-based static analysis framework, originally proposed for automated DAE generation, by introducing a hardware-aware refinement layer. We identify a counter-intuitive Performance Inversion Paradox linked to baseline memory stalls, where high-stall, grid-based kernels reach peak performance at minimal channel depths and suffer up to a 61% throughput degradation when depths are increased. We propose a Heuristic Refinement Layer that optimizes OpenCL channel depths based on this correlation between baseline stalls and performance saturation. Experimental results demonstrate that our expanded framework successfully identifies the Minimal Peak Performance point across various benchmarks. By avoiding the performance traps of standard over-provisioning, we achieve a 2.52x improvement in Resource Efficiency for an illustrative HotSpot application. This approach maintains peak execution speedup while ensuring the leanest possible hardware profile, outperforming conservative tool-based static predictions.

papers.title_en: XRust: Detecting Logical Races in Rust Linux Drivers
papers.authors: Qingxiao Xu, Ze Sheng, Zhicheng Chen, Arjun Manikandan, Jeff Huang
papers.evidence: Linux内核Rust驱动中内存安全与逻辑竞态检测，涉及内核子系统并发行为分析
papers.tldr: Rust用于Linux驱动可防内存错误，但无法避免逻辑竞态。XRust基于Logical Happens-Before分析自动识别共享状态访问，构造操作对测试 harness，并用串行差分预言检测不一致并发执行。在Linux 7.3-rc2中发现2个新逻辑竞态，其一已被主线采纳修复。该方法免人工规约、支持真实驱动上下文验证。
papers.abstract_en: Rust is increasingly used in Linux to improve memory safety, but its guarantees do not prevent logical races: individually synchronized operations can still interleave in ways that violate higher-level invariants. Detecting such bugs typically requires manually written specifications and carefully controlled execution environments.   We present XRust, a technique for detecting logical races in Linux Rust drivers without manually specified invariants. Using Logical Happens-Before (LHB) analysis, XRust identifies shared-state accesses relevant to logical ordering, automatically constructs operation-pair harnesses, and uses serial differential oracles to detect concurrent executions inconsistent with either serial order. XRust also uses lightweight userspace abstractions to execute driver code under reproducible schedules. Applied to Linux 7.3-rc2, XRust identifies 17 shared objects across 102 Rust files from ten drivers, constructs 1,654 executable harnesses, and discovers two previously unknown logical races. The rnull block-driver race has been confirmed by Linux maintainers, with a fix accepted into the Linux block subsystem tree.

papers.title_en: D-Pingmesh: Dynamic Probing and Fault Localization for Reconfigurable Datacenter Networks
papers.authors: Yunze Wei, Kaicheng Yang, Xiaohui Xie, Dunkai Mao, Peiying Tao, Yikai Zhao, Bolong Cui, Chen Sun, Bingyang Liu, Kun Tan, Kai Chen, Yong Cui
papers.evidence: 可重构数据中心网络中的探测与故障定位
papers.tldr: 可重构数据中心网络中，传统Pingmesh的固定探测策略导致路径覆盖冗余且遗漏低概率接口。D-Pingmesh提出控制面感知的动态探测与故障定位框架，结合贪心接口覆盖生成、增量式pinglist更新与Rho-EM边界定位器。在8-pod拓扑下任务量降为Pingmesh的1/17.7，微F1提升至0.953。首次实现TPE/TE协同的高效实时监控。
papers.abstract_en: Pingmesh monitors datacenter networks through periodic pings between servers. In reconfigurable datacenter networks, topology engineering (TPE) and traffic engineering (TE) make uniform server-pair probing inefficient: a pinglist wastes budget retesting common paths while missing low-probability interfaces. Frequent control-plane updates further require rapid pinglist refresh, and cause path ambiguity at control-plane boundaries for fault localization. We present D-Pingmesh, a probing and fault-localization system co-designed with the TPE/TE control plane. Its control-plane-aware generator builds task-efficient pinglists by greedily admitting probes with high interface coverage under the current TPE/TE snapshot. An incremental replay-and-repair mechanism updates pinglists across reconfigurations rather than recomputing from scratch. At control-plane boundaries, a Rho-EM localizer jointly infers per-task old/new-path mixture weights and the fault set through EM-style iteration. We evaluate D-Pingmesh on an 8-pod reconfigurable topology under dynamic TPE/TE. At a 0.99 coverage target, D-Pingmesh uses 17.7x fewer tasks than Pingmesh and generates each pinglist about 5.1x faster than RD-Probe. In ns-3 simulation, boundary-aware localization improves micro F1 from 0.871 to 0.953 over the deTector PLL baseline. A testbed deployment demonstrates second-scale fault localization with low host overhead. These results demonstrate that D-Pingmesh is practical for reconfigurable datacenter networks with control-plane-aware monitoring.

papers.title_en: Task-State Governance: A Virtual Machine for Verifiable and Recoverable GUI Agent Execution
papers.authors: Wenkui Yang, Yiming Hao, Kai Zhou, Chengyu Pu, Yuzhe Zhang, Jie Cao, Jin Huang, Shuai Ma, Feng Tian
papers.evidence: TaskVM是一种用于可验证GUI智能体执行的虚拟机
papers.tldr: GUI代理在真实应用中执行任务时易发生状态漂移，用户难以追溯变更与恢复。本文提出任务态治理范式，构建TaskVM虚拟机实现可验证、可恢复的GUI执行。实验表明其提升契约合规性与用户恢复控制力，且不牺牲执行效果。该工作开辟了可治理代理界面的新设计空间。
papers.abstract_en: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents now execute workflows across real applications, but when execution drifts, users must determine what changed, what should have remained untouched, and what can still be recovered. Plan-centric interfaces leave users supervising procedure, but users live with changes to application state. We introduce task-state governance, an interaction paradigm that represents a task as an editable contract linking desired outcomes, facts that must be preserved, and observed application state. We instantiate this paradigm in TaskVM, which projects live state into editable task controls, executes user edits as genuine interface actions, verifies outcomes through independent observation, and marks each action as reversible, compensatable, or irreversible. Across an automated contract benchmark, a controlled user study, and an open live-model exploration, the paradigm strengthened contract compliance and users' recovery control and trust, while execution outcomes were held constant. Task contracts open a design space for governable agent interfaces.

papers.title_en: Amora: Communication-Efficient Private Approximate Nearest Neighbors Search
papers.authors: Qiuhao Wang, Zuowei Chen, Xu Yang, Saiyu Qi, Yong Qi
papers.evidence: 面向云托管向量数据库的私有近似最近邻搜索
papers.tldr: 云上近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）面临查询向量泄露用户敏感意图的隐私风险。Amora提出双PIR分片图索引与批量查询机制，将PIR开销从每顶点降至每分区。通信量降低93–99%，同时提升检索精度。显著推进单服务器私有ANNS的实用化边界。
papers.abstract_en: Approximate nearest neighbors search (ANNS) over cloud-hosted vector databases raises a critical privacy concern: the query vector, which often encodes sensitive user intent, is exposed to the server. Private ANNS (PANNS) allows a client to retrieve nearest neighbors without revealing its query. The state-of-the-art single-server scheme, Pacmann (ICLR'25), achieves high accuracy via graph-based search with private information retrieval (PIR), but incurs substantial communication overhead because each PIR query retrieves only a single vertex. We present Amora, a communication-efficient PANNS system that applies SimplePIR to a partitioned graph index so that one PIR query is amortized over many vertices. To retrieve as much of the distance and neighbor information the search needs under a limited communication budget, Amora adopts a dual-PIR split layout with two heterogeneous PIR matrices that stay balanced in dimension: VecPIR retrieves inner products for an entire partition of vertices as their distance at once, while NbrPIR retrieves necessary neighbor lists at subgroup granularity for graph traversal. This layout shifts the cost model of PIR query from per-vertex to per-partition, which significantly reduces the communication overhead. To further improve efficiency by reducing the number of scans and query rounds in the PIR database, Amora introduces batch PIR to pack multiple queries into one matrix multiplication, centroid-based pruning to filter unpromising partitions, and TopCand exploration that seeds jump-style graph navigation with the closest vertices from each retrieved partition. We evaluate Amora on five datasets spanning 96 to 1024 dimensions and up to 10 million vectors. Compared to Pacmann, Amora reduces online communication by 93--99% while achieving higher search accuracy.

papers.title_en: PrairieFire: Igniting High-Throughput Updates in Large-Scale Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
papers.authors: Yuchen Huang, Baiteng Ma, Yiping Sun, Xiao Chen, Rui Ma, Yue Chen, Jinwei Zhang, Xiaocheng Zhong, Zhiyong Wang, Yao Hu, Erci Xu, Chuliang Weng
papers.evidence: 面向云规模检索的SSD加速近似最近邻搜索系统
papers.tldr: 现代NVMe SSD阵列带宽逼近内存但成本更低，百亿级向量ANNS正转向SSD部署。现有方案因CPU密集型更新路径导致吞吐瓶颈，难以应对数据与模型持续更新。PrairieFire通过缓冲更新、批处理局部重建及CPU-GPU-SSD协同设计突破限制。实测更新吞吐达SOTA系统3–35倍，搜索吞吐保持3–5倍，成本效率提升1.5–8.7倍。
papers.abstract_en: Arrays of modern NVMe SSDs are approaching memory in terms of bandwidth while offering much lower cost per gigabyte. Hence, approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) for billion-scale vectors in applications such as recommendation, search, and retrieval-augmented generation increasingly runs on SSD-based systems. Unfortunately, due to the limited update throughput of existing SSD-based solutions, the indexed corpus cannot keep pace with continuous modifications to data and embedding models, thus hindering broader deployment across more scenarios and larger scales.   The bottleneck lies in CPU-intensive update paths, where foreground insertions incur frequent SSD accesses and background reassignments repeatedly relocate each vector, making high update throughput difficult to achieve even by exhausting available hardware. In this paper, using buffered updates and batched local rebuilds, we develop PrairieFire with cascaded adjustments, concurrency control, and CPU-GPU-SSD cooperation. These co-designs avoid frequent SSD accesses in foreground updates and heavy background reassignments, achieving high update throughput while maintaining excellent search performance.   Evaluations show that, compared with state-of-the-art systems, PrairieFire can sustain approximately 3-35x update throughput while maintaining approximately 3-5x search throughput simultaneously. It also achieves approximately 1.5-8.7x cost efficiency. PrairieFire has been deployed in RedNote's production environments for two months, improving business metrics by higher freshness without frequent index rebuilds.

papers.title_en: PlaneZip: Lossless Bit-Plane Compression of Training Activations Offloaded over PCIe
papers.authors: Zhufan Gu, Qizhe Tang, Yuxin Wang, Xun Zhou, Hui Feng
papers.evidence: 面向内存受限虚拟化训练的PCIe卸载压缩
papers.tldr: GPU训练受显存限制需频繁卸载激活值，但PCIe带宽瓶颈使传统交换代价高昂。PlaneZip在拷贝路径上实时进行位平面无损压缩，并重构调度器以适配压缩后传输时间。在五种真实模型上，BF16/FP32激活平均压缩率达1.71x/1.39x，显著优于零值压缩。该方法大幅降低重计算开销，硬件开销仅0.036 mm²。
papers.abstract_en: Training under a device-memory budget relies on tensor rematerialization: an evicted activation is either swapped to host memory or dropped and recomputed. Because GPU compute has outgrown PCIe bandwidth, cost-model planners such as MegTaiChi, which charge a swap its full transfer time, almost never swap, and swaps that fill idle link time carry only a small fraction of the saved activations. Saved activations, however, are homogeneously typed arrays with bit-level redundancy beyond zeros, which lightweight bit-plane compressors can remove at line rate. We present PlaneZip, which compresses swapped tensors on the copy path and plans around the compression. Its codec picks, for every 128-byte block, the smallest of zero-value, delta bit-plane, bit-plane, and a new zero-masked bit-plane encoding. A per-tensor predictor reuses the ratio of the previous iteration, and the planner budgets link time in compressed transfer times. On activations captured from five models trained on real data, the codec compresses BF16 activations by 1.71x and FP32 activations by 1.39x (geometric means), against 1.18x and 1.20x for zero-value compression. In trace-driven simulation of a PCIe 3.0 consumer GPU and a PCIe 4.0 datacenter GPU at half the activation memory, PlaneZip cuts the rematerialization overhead by 47% and 31% relative to a bandwidth-aware planner without compression, and by 73% and 54% relative to MegTaiChi's cost model, with an estimated engine area of 0.036 square millimeters.

papers.title_en: Where the SRAM Goes: Per-Symbol Attribution of Static Memory in FreeRTOS-C and Embassy-Rust IoT Firmware on a 64 KB RISC-V Microcontroller
papers.authors: Romi Fadli, Jan Everhard Riwurohi, Wahyu Ramadani Putri Utami, Zulfa Malika Amana
papers.evidence: RTOS固件中按符号的静态内存归因方法可迁移至Linux内核内存布局分析
papers.tldr: 嵌入式固件选型常依赖整体二进制大小，却无法揭示SRAM具体去向。本文提出基于ELF符号的每符号静态内存归因方法，将64 KB RISC-V MCU上的SRAM细分为调度堆、网络缓冲池、任务栈等架构类别。在FreeRTOS-C与Embassy-Rust双栈十六个构建中实现100%总量对齐；发现lwIP网络开销是smoltcp的4.4倍。工具、数据与固件全部开源，填补内存归因方法论空白。
papers.abstract_en: Selecting a firmware stack for a memory-constrained microcontroller is usually guided by aggregate binary sizes, which report how much SRAM a build consumes but not where it goes or why. We address that gap with a per-symbol attribution method that decomposes static RAM into architectural categories - scheduler heap, network buffers and pools, task stacks, and linker-reserved regions - by bounding sized ELF symbols to the .data, .bss and .stack section ranges. The method is validated by reconciling every category sum exactly against the size-based totals for all sixteen builds. We apply it to eight cumulative firmware milestones, from a bare task scaffold to a full MQTT-over-Ethernet client, implemented twice, in FreeRTOS-C and in Embassy-Rust, on the CH32V203RBT6, a RISC-V microcontroller with 64 KB SRAM and an on-chip Ethernet MAC and PHY, with functional parity verified on hardware at every milestone. The decomposition shows that both stacks spend a nearly identical share of their RAM on networking (63.8% versus 63.9%), yet the absolute cost differs by 4.4 times: 40,719 bytes for lwIP against 9,316 bytes for smoltcp. FreeRTOS task stacks grow linearly at roughly 1 KB per task while Embassy async state grows with state-machine complexity. We also report that lwIP could not be integrated under an all-static discipline on this platform, requiring a 20 KB arena that smoltcp does not. The measurement harness, the attribution tool, and the sixteen firmware implementations are released as artefacts.

papers.title_en: HardEval: An Execution-Verified Benchmark for AI-Driven Security Hardening and Compliance Remediation
papers.authors: Manohar Vellala, Soumya Banerjee, Sandip Roy, Ross Gore, Sachin Shetty
papers.evidence: 通过内核参数配置与审计规则实施操作系统级安全加固
papers.tldr: STIG安全配置实施长期依赖人工，现有基准无法评估模型在真实系统上的硬加固能力。HardEval构建于RHEL8 STIG失败项，通过执行Bash脚本并用OpenSCAP/OVAL验证结果。14个前沿与开源模型表现差异显著，常见错误是生成看似合理却未通过精确合规检查的代码。该基准首次实现执行级验证，已开源。
papers.abstract_en: Implementing Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) controls remains a demanding operating-system administration task. Each natural-language security requirement must be translated into a precise and persistent configuration change. These changes span Secure Shell (SSH) configuration, authentication policy, audit rules, and kernel parameters. Existing benchmarks do not measure whether a model can perform this task on a live system. Code benchmarks evaluate isolated programs without persistent system state, while agent benchmarks largely focus on applications rather than operating-system configuration. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{HardEval}, an execution-verified benchmark for evaluating language-model-assisted security hardening. HardEval is built from Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 STIG controls that fail on an unhardened baseline system. Expert-written reference remediations and Open Vulnerability and Assessment Language (OVAL) checks serve as hidden ground truth for grading; they are never shown to the model, and each task states only the required security outcome while withholding the implementation. The model produces a Bash script, which is executed on a live virtual machine and graded from fail to pass using the corresponding OpenSCAP/OVAL compliance check. Evaluation of fourteen frontier and open-weight configurations reveals large and uneven capability differences across security domains. A recurring failure mode is plausible security code that does not satisfy the exact compliance condition. For four open-weight configurations, multi-run Wilson confidence intervals preserve the observed ordering. HardEval is publicly available.

papers.title_en: A Critical Review of Grid Integration Challenges and Flexibility Opportunities for Large-Scale Data Centers
papers.authors: Bibek Dhakal, Manohar Chamana, Biswambhar Gayen, Jatendar Kumar, S M Shams Rahman, Aaqib Peerzada, Ki Yeob Lee, Olatunji M. Adeyanju, Bhaskar Mitra, Soumya Kundu, Stephen Bayne
papers.evidence: 云计算数据中心基础设施与电网集成挑战
papers.tldr: AI与云计算驱动数据中心负荷激增，其高密度、变流器主导、热电耦合等特性带来新型电网接入挑战。本文系统梳理配电层关键问题并对比七类负荷模型，评估多维度灵活性资源。发现仅靠峰荷与年电量匹配无法保障可靠可持续接入。研究为数据中心-电网协同规划提供了全链条评估框架。
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of cloud computing and artificial intelligence workloads is fundamentally reshaping the magnitude, spatial concentration, and electrical characteristics of data center power demand. Data centers differ from conventional commercial loads because they combine high rack densities, converter-dominated interfaces, thermally coupled cooling, uninterruptible power supplies, programmable workloads, and increasingly complex behind-the-meter generation and storage within a single facility. This review examines their grid integration from utility and sustainable-energy perspectives across resource planning, large-load interconnection, distribution feeders, market operation, real-time dynamics, power quality, and asset management. Particular attention is given to distribution-level issues that receive limited treatment in broader energy reviews: bidirectional operation on renewable-rich feeders, harmonic propagation and resonance, ride-through and reconnection, transformer derating, cable ampacity, neutral-conductor heating, protection, and measurement. Static, composite, physics-based dynamic, calibrated, impedance, electromagnetic transient, and hybrid load models are compared according to study purpose and data requirements, and utility coordination platforms, uninterruptible power supply and battery control, workload flexibility, renewable co-location, cogeneration, fuel cells, thermal storage, and clean firm supply are assessed. The central finding is that requested peak demand and annual energy matching alone cannot establish reliable or sustainable integration. Credible assessment must consider hourly and locational supply, network deliverability, marginal emissions, lifecycle and water impacts, backup obligations, rebound, asset health, and verified operating capability.

papers.title_en: Data Center Load Accommodation under QoS and Checkpoint-Induced Frequency Security Constraints
papers.authors: Ruolan Cui, Ziang Liu, Chenxi Hu, Francis Yunhe Hou
papers.evidence: 面向AI工作负载动态性与电网约束的数据中心负荷接纳
papers.tldr: AI训练负载激增推动数据中心与电网深度耦合，但传统DCLA评估忽略QoS与频率安全约束。本文提出联合建模QoS、checkpoint-induced FS及电网充裕性的两阶段字典序优化方法。相比基准，DCLA高估达40.3%；QoS为主导瓶颈，FS约束随训练负载增长而加剧。成果支撑兼顾电网支撑价值与运行风险的可靠DCLA评估。
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence workloads is accelerating the expansion and grid interconnection of data centers (DCs). Existing data center load accommodation (DCLA) assessments primarily focus on grid and resource adequacy and often imply that greater workload flexibility always increases accommodable capacity. However, workload flexibility has a dual effect. Workload deferral and temporal shifting can alleviate network congestion, whereas synchronized checkpointing of training workloads can cause large and rapid load reductions, threatening frequency stability. Therefore, DCLA cannot be determined solely by grid adequacy. This paper develops an optimal DCLA method that jointly accounts for workload quality of service (QoS), checkpoint-induced frequency security (FS), and grid adequacy. First, a QoS-aware model characterizes workload-dependent flexibility while ensuring service feasibility. Second, checkpoint-induced FS constraints are developed for periodic and event-triggered power variations, with key frequency-security limits reformulated in algebraic form. Third, a two-stage lexicographic model is developed to maximize DCLA and minimizes the required energy storage (ES) deployment, and then optimizes system operation under the given DC and ES siting and sizing decisions. Case studies show that the proposed method avoids a 40.3% overestimation of DCLA compared with the grid-adequacy benchmark. QoS is the primary limiting factor, while checkpoint-induced frequency-security constraints become more restrictive as training workloads increase. These findings highlight that reliable DCLA should account for both its grid-support value and the associated QoS and FS risks.

papers.title_en: RemoteANN: A Native Vector Search Engine for Cloud Object Storage
papers.authors: Yutong Gou, Silu Huang, Yue Wang, Jianjun Chen, Cheng Long
papers.evidence: 专为云对象存储协同设计的向量搜索引擎
papers.tldr: 云对象存储上的向量检索因网络延迟高、请求开销大而面临I/O放大与吞吐瓶颈。RemoteANN面向S3类存储原生设计，融合IVF索引、RaBitQ量化与数据重排序提升局部性。查询阶段结合簇剪枝、Range-GET、请求合并与NVMe缓存，大幅降低请求数与传输量。在97%召回率下实现5.9×吞吐提升与16.1×请求削减，显著降本增效。
papers.abstract_en: Vector search engines built on cloud object storage have drawn growing attention from both academia and industry. These systems typically adopt a disaggregated storage-compute architecture, persisting the primary vector payload in object stores (e.g., Amazon S3) while retaining compact index metadata on compute nodes. However, conventional vector indexing structures are not natively tailored to the pronounced network latency and per-request access costs of cloud object stores, resulting in network I/O amplification, degraded query throughput, and higher API expenses.   To resolve these challenges, we present RemoteANN, a vector search engine explicitly co-designed for cloud object storage across indexing and querying. To mitigate the dominant network I/O bottleneck, RemoteANN couples an Inverted File (IVF) index with RaBitQ quantization, further optimized by inter-cluster and intra-cluster data reordering for improved data locality. Building on this tailored data layout, RemoteANN's query engine combines cluster pruning, fine-grained Range-GET requests, request merging, and local NVMe SSD caching, dramatically reducing discrete storage requests and network transfer volume without sacrificing accuracy. To address the index construction bottleneck, we further develop QGKMeans, which substantially reduces construction latency without compromising clustering quality. Extensive evaluations on real-world datasets demonstrate that, compared with representative baselines, RemoteANN achieves up to a $5.9\times$ throughput speedup while issuing up to $16.1\times$ fewer object storage requests at 97% target recall.
